weather.howBody: Spray: good when wind is 3–15 km/h, gusts under 25, under 35 °C and no rain likely for 6 hours, between 5 AM and 7 PM. Irrigation: the crop's daily water use (ET₀ × crop factor for its stage) is added up from your last logged irrigation, minus useful rain (80% of days with 5 mm or more). When the used water reaches what the roots can easily take from your soil type, irrigation is due. Rice is kept flooded. All advice is a guide only.

heatwave.title: Heatwave: up to {{value}}°C for 2 or more days
heatwave.body: Irrigate in the evening or early morning and don't spray in the afternoon.

heat-stress.title: Heat stress for {{crop}}: {{value}}°C
heat-stress.body: This is a sensitive stage. A light evening irrigation helps; don't spray in the heat.

frost.title: Frost risk for {{crop}}: down to {{value}}°C
frost.body: A light irrigation the evening before helps protect the crop.

heavy-rain.title: Heavy rain: about {{value}} mm
heavy-rain.body: Clear field drains and wait with fertilizer and spraying.

strong-wind.title: Strong wind: gusts up to {{value}} km/h
strong-wind.body: Don't spray. Tall crops may fall over.

fog.title: Fog expected
fog.body: Low visibility on the roads. Long wet leaves favour fungal disease; wait with spraying until it clears.

wheat-yellow-rust.title: Yellow rust weather for wheat
wheat-yellow-rust.body: Cool, humid or rainy days ahead. Check lower leaves for yellow stripes.

rice-blast.title: Rice blast weather
rice-blast.body: Several warm, very humid nights ahead. Look for eye-shaped spots on leaves.

cotton-boll-rot.title: Boll rot weather for cotton
cotton-boll-rot.body: Rain followed by warm, humid hours. Check opening bolls for rot and the leaves for blight spots.

rice.title: {{crop}}: keep standing water
rice.body: Keep about 5–7 cm of water in the field and top it up when it's gone.
rice.rain: About {{mm}} mm of rain is expected in the next 3 days, so no top-up is needed until then.

logNeeded.title: Log the last irrigation of {{crop}}
logNeeded.body: Then the app can work out when it needs water next.

limited.title: Not enough weather data for {{crop}}
limited.body: Irrigation advice needs recent weather back to the last irrigation (up to 30 days). Log a recent irrigation or try again later.

skip.title: Skip irrigation for {{crop}}
skip.body: About {{mm}} mm of rain is expected in the next 3 days. The crop uses about {{need}} mm a day.

irrigation.okLater_one: {{crop}}: no irrigation needed for at least {{count}} day
irrigation.okLater_other: {{crop}}: no irrigation needed for at least {{count}} days
irrigation.body: The crop uses about {{need}} mm of water a day. About {{used}} of {{raw}} mm of easily usable water is used since the last irrigation or rain.
